description: Defines classes and methods for constructing and manipulating rtnetlink messages used for network configuration in Linux, including link, address, route, and rule messages.

classes.name: RtnetlinkMessage
classes.description: Base class for constructing rtnetlink messages, managing message headers and attributes.

classes.name: LinkMessage
classes.description: Derived class for link-level configuration messages.

classes.name: AddressMessage
classes.description: Derived class for address-level configuration messages.

classes.name: RouteMessage
classes.description: Derived class for routing table messages.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a rtnetlink message with header parameters.

methods.name: AppendAttribute
methods.description: Appends an attribute to the message, handling length calculations.

methods.name: BuildIoVec
methods.description: Builds an array of iovec structures for sendmsg.

methods.name: IoVecSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the iovec array.

methods.name: AdjustMessageLength
methods.description: Adjusts the message length in the header based on additional data.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Static factory method to create new instances of link, address, route, or rule messages.
